headline: Advanced Honors Italian 3 curriculum and six policy and regulation revisions forward for consent.
summary: Staff gave an update on the Center for Innovation and Design, covering enrollment, revenue, and future programming. Several policy changes follow Public Acts 26-1, 26-13, and 26-125, including a requirement for asthma action plans.
decisions: Referred the Honors Italian 3 curriculum revisions to the full board for consent.
Referred revisions to Policy 5131 on student discipline to the full board for consent.
Referred revisions to Policy 5141.3 on health assessments and screenings to the full board for consent.
Referred revisions to Policy 5131.311 on immunizations to the full board for consent.
Referred revisions to Policy 4152.6/4252.6 on family medical leave to the full board for consent.
Referred revisions to Bylaw 9311 on board policies to the full board for consent.
Referred revisions to Regulation 5145.4a on students and Section 504 to the full board for consent.
